source.title: Data for: Sputtering of polished EUROFER97 steel: surface structure modification and enrichment of tungsten and tantalum
source.description: AFM data for initial surface roughness on all samples

candidate_disposition.reason: The source supplies AFM height maps but no independent measured Ra, Rq, and peak-density target table. Deriving those targets directly from each input height map would reproduce the frozen plane-detrend/RMS baseline rather than provide independent experimental truth that a learned model can beat.
